'''2003 Origins Matt Lush LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Lush]] at [[2003 Origins]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Matt "Old Skooler" Lush (2003-06-30).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29484 Senatorium]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070921063540/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29484 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Event uncertain: "went 4-0 at Origins" (Origins 2003); which Origins event and final placement are not stated.<ref name="src" />
